references.text: The same prohibition against turning to mediums and spiritists is found here, where Israel is warned not to become unclean by seeking them
The punishment for those who practice mediumship or divination themselves - they shall be stoned
Moses repeats the prohibition against mediumship, divination, and seeking counsel from the dead as an abomination to the Lord
Saul had himself driven out the mediums from the land, yet he turned to a medium at En-Dor anyway
King Manasseh practiced mediumship and divination, which was evil in the sight of the Lord
King Josiah destroyed the mediums and spiritists as part of his religious reform
The sin of King Manasseh included mediumship and divination, which did much evil in the sight of the Lord
Isaiah condemns those who seek mediums and spiritists instead of seeking their God
Ezekiel uses the same expression that God sets his face against those who turn away from him to idols
Hosea describes Israel's spiritual unfaithfulness as prostitution - the same term is used for seeking mediums
